SLIDE 3: TECHNICAL APPROACH
Human Eye Flow & Psychology

Under the hood, we designed a zero-GPU, commodity CPU architecture. Our dual-stream pipeline runs parallel BM25 and ONNX bge-small embeddings, merged with RRF (k=60) and cross-encoder reranking.
